name: typed-fixture-kinds
title: Fixtures are built from the writer types, not from memory
description: A probe of mine invented the kind task.resource.observed, which does not exist - the appender writes task.convergence.observed and the failure reading reads it - so a fabricated fixture produced a conclusion about the code that was wrong. The durable fix is typing every fixture kind as ExecutionRecordKind, which is the same mistake the suite could make
creator: aixi
